outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 131 offspring of 137 nulliparous women diagnosed with GDM who delivered for the first time between January 1, 2010 and March 1, 2013
finding: Offspring of nulliparous women with GDM were more likely to be delivered by emergency cesarean section and experience neonatal hypoglycaemia compared to nulliparous women in general.
mod_finding: The offspring of nulliparous women with GDM were more likely to be delivered by emergency cesarean section compared to nulliparous women in general.
birth_weight: Most offspring had a birth weight within the normal range and only 4.6% were large for gestational age.
